facts.fact: Decree D/2019/132 of 13 May 2019 creates CREDPOL within the Ministry of Security and Civil Protection to run the national police information system SIPG, whose offence-processing component is fed by designated police and gendarmerie officers.
Article 9 of the decree gives CREDPOL an annual budget allocation entered in the national budget.

systems.owner: CREDPOL, under the Ministry of Security and Civil Protection
systems.tiers: national police, gendarmerie, customs, nature conservators, justice; terminals in the services, no station named

note: Decree creating the system; it states no live use, no station entry and no share of stations, so no records, made or stations fact. Other SIPG files (stolen vehicles, wanted persons) are identification/exchange.
